subject: ProofPoint Health trial environment recommendation & milestones
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@proofpointhealth.com>, Sara Cho <sara.cho@proofpointhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: ProofPoint Health trial environment recommendation & milestones

Hi Amit / Sara —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Short recap and a proposed path for the trial so we can align on success criteria and owners: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for PH’s document ingestion + QA assistant workload (avg prompt length ~400 tokens, bursty peak 200 rps).
- Data sensitivity: PH needs audit logs + optional customer-managed keys for PII processing.
- Success: 95% availability during test, generation latency p95 < 180ms for scoped traffic, acceptable cost-per-1000 tokens estimate for production.

Recommended trial environment (our call):
1) Hosted API sandbox (fastest to start) for the feature-level validation (first 2 weeks).
2) Parallel Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) if you want representative throughput and KV cache behavior — we can spin this after week 1 if you approve.
3) Optional VPC/private deployment for encryption-at-rest + KMS proof-of-concept (only required if PH legal signs off on on-premises eval).

Proposed timeline & milestones
- Day 0 (this week): Redwood provides POC checklist + sanitized sample prompts (attached: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx).
- Week 1: Hosted sandbox up; ingest sample corpus; quick smoke tests; weekly sync.
- Week 2–3: Execute throughput tests on Dedicated sandbox (if enabled); capture latency/cost metrics and traces.
- End of week 3: Joint review — success decision (go/no-go) and production path recommendation.

Owners / next steps
- PH owner: Amit (technical) / Sara (procurement) — confirm any network constraints and whether a dedicated pool is required.
- Redwood owner: Ben Carter (ops lead) for sandbox provisioning; Karthik for security checklist items.
- Action for Amit: confirm whether PH needs KMS/HSM integration during the trial or only audit logs.

Open questions for you
- Do you need the Dedicated sandbox provisioned from day 1 (adds ~2 business days for capacity allocation)?
- Any internal compliance gating that would require VPC isolation before we start ingesting samples?

I’ve attached a one-page checklist and a stubbed network requirements PDF to make the initial steps easier. If this path looks reasonable I’ll kick off the hosted sandbox today and schedule the first status call for Friday.

Thanks —

Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwoodinference.example

Attachments:
- redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet: trial scope, sample prompts, minimal success metrics)
- network-requirements-stub.pdf (stub: ports/ips, egress rules)

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@proofpointhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Cho <sara.cho@proofpointhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ProofPoint Health trial environment recommendation & milestones

Rachel — thanks for the quick recap and suggested path. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) KMS/HSM: We prefer to see audit logs and RBAC first. KMS will likely be required for production, but not mandatory for the initial hosted sandbox.
2) Dedicated pool: We’d like to enable Dedicated sandbox mid-week 2 to validate burst handling at scale.
3) Data: We can start with de-identified documents for Week 1 and push a small PII set behind VPC only if Week 2 tests look good.

Action: I can confirm the procurement lead (Sara) will start internal approvals today. Please go ahead and provision the hosted sandbox and share credentials/instructions.

One more ask: can you include an estimated cost delta between hosted and dedicated for the benchmarked traffic (ballpark $/1k tokens)? That will help expedite procurement.

—Amit
Lead Platform Engineer
ProofPoint Health
amit.shah@proofpointhealth.com

Amit / Rachel — great plan. Quick notes from ops/security perspective: 

- Hosted sandbox: I can have credentials and a scoped API key to you within 24 hours. It will be rate-limited to mirror the expected dev traffic.
- Dedicated sandbox: provisioning lead time is ~48 hours after we receive PH acceptance to allocate capacity. We will provide a config file for batching/QoS to match your latency targets.
- Cost delta: ballpark (based on the profile you shared) — Hosted: $1.2–$1.6 per 1k tokens (includes shared infra). Dedicated: $0.6–$0.9 per 1k tokens (amortized on reserved pool) — final numbers after we run the workload.
- Security: Karthik will collect the SOC2 checklist items; audit logs will be available in both Hosted and Dedicated. VPC requires a short network enablement window and an SOW addendum.

I’ve attached the minimal network requirements and the provisioning runbook (referenced in Rachel’s attachment). Next steps: Rachel to provision hosted sandbox; I’ll start the Dedicated request on Friday if Amit confirms.

Ben Carter
